Several recent studies indicate… 16728949 cell-stem-cell-review-foxo-transcription-factors-and-stem-cell-homeostasis:-insights-from-the-hematopoietic-system cell stem review foxo transcription factors homeostasis insights The forkhead O (FoxO) family of transcription factors participates in diverse physiol Cell Stem Cell Review FoxO Transcription Factors and Stem Cell Homeostasis: Insights from the Hematopoietic System The forkhead O (FoxO) family of transcription factors participates in diverse physiologic processes, including induction of cell-cycle arrest, stress resistance, differentiation, apoptosis, and metabolism. Several recent studies indicate that FoxO-dependent signaling is required for long-term regenerative potential of the hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) compartment through regulation of HSC response to physiologic oxidative stress, quiescence, and survival. These observations link FoxO function in mammalian systems with the evolutionarily conserved role of FoxO in promotion of stress resistance and longevity in lower phylogenetic systems.
